ring_buffer_architecture.sample_invalidation_rule: Samples where (t_current - t_sample) > 0.100s are excluded from estimation

least_squares_linear_regression.name: Rolling Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) Linear Fit
least_squares_linear_regression.role: Primary release velocity estimation algorithm in _UIScrollViewVelocity
least_squares_linear_regression.denominator_zero_protection: if sum_{i=1}^N (t_i - t_bar)^2 < 1e-9 then fallback to finite difference v = (P_latest - P_earliest) / (t_latest - t_earliest)
least_squares_linear_regression.advantages: Suppresses physiological micro-tremors, contact area centroid fluctuations, and digitizer quantum quantization noise without phase lag

exponential_moving_average_filter.name: Single-Pole IIR Coordinate Pre-Filter (EMA)
exponential_moving_average_filter.role: Pre-filters raw digitizer coordinates in touchesMoved: prior to regression insertion
exponential_moving_average_filter.advantages: Eliminates high-frequency capacitive sensor jitter while preserving trajectory intent

weighted_finite_difference_fallback.name: Linearly Time-Decayed Finite Difference
weighted_finite_difference_fallback.role: Fallback algorithm when ring buffer contains exactly 2 valid samples

minimum_fling_velocity.description: If release velocity magnitude ||v|| < 10.0 pt/s, no inertial fling animation is launched; content rests at current position immediately

maximum_fling_velocity_cap.description: Hard upper bound capping velocity vector magnitude ||v|| to prevent runaway ballistic projection and multi-page overshoot

terminal_stop_velocity.description: Inertial deceleration terminates when instantaneous velocity drops below 0.1 pt/s

directional_projections_and_locking.vertical_projection_rule: If initial gesture vector angle >= 60 deg from horizontal: horizontal velocity clamped to 0.0 (v_x = 0.0)
directional_projections_and_locking.horizontal_projection_rule: If initial gesture vector angle <= 30 deg from horizontal: vertical velocity clamped to 0.0 (v_y = 0.0)
directional_projections_and_locking.diagonal_neutral_zone: Between 30 deg and 60 deg: both velocity components preserved (unlocked 2D pan)
directional_projections_and_locking.classification_formula: theta = atan2(|dy|, |dx|); theta >= pi/3 -> Vertical, theta <= pi/6 -> Horizontal, else None

screen_to_view_transformation.description: Transforms raw touch screen coordinates into target scroll view local coordinate system accounting for view hierarchy scales, rotations, and safe area offsets

pan_to_scroll_velocity_sign_inversion.kinematic_derivation: A positive user finger drag in the positive X/Y direction moves content forward, which corresponds to decreasing the viewport bounds contentOffset origin (Delta_offset = -Delta_touch). Deceleration must continue this motion, requiring inversion of the pan recognizer velocity vector.

multi_touch_centroid_synthesis.description: Calculates arithmetic mean across active touches to arbitrate conflicting multi-finger flings

stationary_pause_detection.rule: If t_current - t_last_sample > 0.100s, release velocity is clamped to (0.0, 0.0)

duplicate_timestamp_deduplication.rule: If incoming sample timestamp matches preceding sample (dt < 1us), sample coordinate is updated in place without advancing ring buffer head

velocity_caching_and_invalidation.cache_validation_rule: If cacheTimestamp matches latestSampleTimestamp and cacheTimestamp > 0.0, return cached regression vector without recomputation
velocity_caching_and_invalidation.cache_invalidation_event: addSample:atTimestamp: resets cacheTimestamp = 0.0 upon inserting any new contact point

binary_symbols_and_entry_points.role: Inserts touch sample into 8-element ring buffer and evicts expired samples (>100ms)
Computes rolling least-squares velocity estimate across valid ring buffer samples
Returns release velocity transformed to specified view coordinate system
Specialized scroll velocity query incorporating transferred ballistic momentum
